rules.statement: The purchaser of hypothecated land at a sale by the Fiscal in execution of a decree in a suit to realize the mortgage has a superior title over the purchaser at a sale by the Fiscal of the same land in execution of the judgment of an unsecured creditor against the mortgagor.
rules.supporting_quote: 'I am of opinion that the appeal must be allowed. The question to be decided is, whether the purchaser of hypothecated land at a sale by the Fiscal in execution of a decree in a suit to realize the mortgage, or the purchaser at a sale by the Fiscal of the same land in execution of the judgment of an unsecured creditor against the mortgagor, has the better title.'
